definition: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
example: There was abundant evidence to support the theory.

definition: Well meaning and kindly.
example: A benevolent smile crossed his face.

definition: Truthful and straightforward; frank.
example: His responses were remarkably candid.

definition: Having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.
example: Many years of diligent work were rewarded with success.

definition: Lasting for a very short time.
example: Fashions are ephemeral, but style is eternal.

definition: Happening by accident or chance rather than design.
example: The similarity between the paintings may not be simply fortuitous.

definition: Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters.
example: He is portrayed as a foolish, garrulous old man.

definition: Arrogantly superior and disdainful.
example: A look of haughty disdain.

definition: The quality of being certain to happen.
example: There was a sense of inevitability about the outcome.

definition: Place or deal with close together for contrasting effect.
example: Black-and-white photos of slums were starkly juxtaposed with color images.

definition: Expressed clearly; easy to understand.
example: A lucid account of a complex topic.

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
example: He had always been so meticulous about his appearance.

definition: A person new to or inexperienced in a field or situation.
example: He was a complete novice in foreign affairs.

definition: Not discovered or known about; uncertain.
example: His origins and parentage are obscure.

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically.
example: A pragmatic approach to politics.

definition: Representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class.
example: He was the quintessential tough guy.

definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
example: Babies are generally far more resilient than new parents realize.

definition: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough.
example: The purchaser should avoid asking for superfluous information.

definition: Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or adhering closely.
example: A tenacious grip.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.
example: His ubiquitous influence was felt by all the family.
